title: Super
text: We had a tour guide through Santa Cruz with Juan Carlos who was with the City Sightseeing company. We found him to be utterly brilliant. He seemed very interested in the topics he was talking about and very knowledgable too. There was a really lovely variety of history and we could hear him very clearly. Well worth an hour with juan Carlos
